events.title: US September CPI — +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y
events.why_it_matters: Headline inflation accelerated to 3.7% y/y and core firmed, keeping a December Fed hike on the table despite today's expected pause.
events.what_to_watch: October CPI on Nov 10; a second upside surprise would cement a December hike.

events.title: US September retail sales — +0.8% m/m
events.why_it_matters: The upside surprise was flattered by gasoline; ex-gas growth was only 0.2%, so the consumer picture is weaker than the headline.
events.what_to_watch: October retail sales and holiday-season guidance from retailers.

events.title: China Q3 GDP — 4.5% y/y, beats 4.3% prior
events.why_it_matters: Growth accelerated from Q2 and kept China inside the 4.5–5% annual target, reducing near-term stimulus urgency but supporting global cyclical sentiment.
events.what_to_watch: October PMI on Oct 31 and whether policymakers add incremental stimulus at the NPC session.

events.title: China September industrial production +5.5%, retail sales +1.1%
events.why_it_matters: Production beat but consumption remained soft, reinforcing the two-speed China recovery and the case for targeted rather than broad stimulus.
events.what_to_watch: Golden Week consumption data and October retail sales.

events.title: China October LPR held at 3.0%/3.5% for 17th month
events.why_it_matters: The PBOC is prioritising bank margins and a policy-rate overhaul over near-term easing, limiting the impulse to property and credit-sensitive sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the PBOC cuts reserve requirements before year-end to support growth.

events.title: China restricts export of AI and chip-design technologies
events.why_it_matters: Beijing added 23 AI technologies to its export-control list and imposed registration on outbound frontier models and chip IP, escalating tech fragmentation.
events.what_to_watch: Retaliatory licensing actions and whether US chip-equipment firms lose China revenue.

events.title: Taiwan tightens AI chip and server export controls to China
events.why_it_matters: Taipei moved to criminalise unauthorised AI chip and server exports to China, aligning with US restrictions and adding compliance cost to the semiconductor supply chain.
events.what_to_watch: TSMC and server-ODM commentary on licence delays and China revenue exposure.

events.title: Supreme Court IEEPA tariff refunds — CIT certifies importer class
events.why_it_matters: The CIT class certification opens a clearer path for importers to recover IEEPA tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court, a cash-flow positive for retailers but a fiscal negative.
events.what_to_watch: Refund timetable and whether the administration appeals the class certification.

events.title: Trump delays wind turbine tariffs for 180 days
events.why_it_matters: The executive order avoids immediate national-security tariffs on turbines already subject to steel, aluminium and copper duties, easing near-term cost pressure on renewables developers.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the tariff threat returns after the 180-day window in April 2027.

events.title: US sanctions escalate on Russia and Iran energy networks
events.why_it_matters: OFAC targeted Iranian banks and shadow-fleet facilitators while the Graham sanctions act authorises secondary tariffs on buyers of Russian energy, keeping oil supply risk elevated.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation of 100% secondary tariffs on buyers of Russian crude after the 30-day waiver window.

events.title: Meta Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AI ad monetisation and 2027 capex guidance set the tone for the mega-cap AI trade just before Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon report.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Meta's capex guide forces a re-rating of AI infrastructure names.

events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings — profit down 42.7%, beat on EPS
events.why_it_matters: Tesla beat depressed estimates and turned free cash flow positive, but margins and EV demand remain the sector bellwether into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: October China insurance registrations and whether margin recovery holds.

events.title: Netflix Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Ad-tier engagement and pricing trends set the tone for streaming margins and the media complex into year-end.
events.what_to_watch: Ad-tier ARPU and whether price hikes trigger churn.

events.title: France riots and political crisis after cost-of-living protests
events.why_it_matters: France suffered its worst unrest in years, weakening the government and reinforcing the case for the ECB to hold rather than hike on October 29.
events.what_to_watch: Whether unrest spreads to other euro-area countries and pressures OAT-Bund spreads.

events.title: Japan September core CPI rises to 2.1%, core-core 2.4%
events.why_it_matters: Core inflation exceeded 2% for the first time in nine months, strengthening the case for a December BOJ hike even as the October 30 meeting is expected to hold.
events.what_to_watch: BOJ Governor Ueda's press conference on Oct 30 for December hike signals.

events.title: Eurozone October flash PMI misses — services 51.7 vs 52.5 expected
events.why_it_matters: Growth momentum slowed in October while input prices accelerated on energy, leaving the ECB caught between a weak economy and 3.8% inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Eurozone flash CPI and Q3 GDP on Oct 30; a weak GDP print would harden the hold.

events.title: Brent crude above $111 on Strait of Hormuz attacks
events.why_it_matters: Shipping attacks and US-Iran tension keep a geopolitical risk premium in oil, feeding inflation and weighing on consumer-sensitive sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Whether attacks resume after the US midterms and OPEC+'s Nov 1 response.

events.title: TSMC Q3 2026 earnings — record profit, revenue $46.7B
events.why_it_matters: TSMC's sixth consecutive record quarter and strong 2nm ramp confirm the AI semiconductor upcycle remains intact.
events.what_to_watch: Capex guidance for 2027 and whether US export controls slow China-bound revenue.

events.title: South Korea October 1–20 chip exports +222.5% y/y to record $27.5B
events.why_it_matters: Semiconductors now account for 44.7% of Korean exports, confirming the AI-driven memory upcycle is accelerating.
events.what_to_watch: November 1 full-month export data and Samsung/SK Hynix earnings guidance.

events.title: Brazil election — Lula wins; market selloff spills into Argentina
events.why_it_matters: Lula's victory triggered a 15% Bovespa drawdown and a 10% real devaluation, lifting Argentina country risk to 765bp and spreading EM risk aversion.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Brazil's fiscal trajectory forces a rating action and whether contagion hits Mexican and Chilean assets.

events.title: Israel parliamentary election — no bloc wins majority
events.why_it_matters: Exit polls show a near-tie, leaving coalition formation uncertain and raising the risk of policy paralysis ahead of a possible Iran escalation.
events.what_to_watch: Coalition talks over the next two weeks and whether a new government changes the Iran posture.

events.title: FOMC rate decision — hold at 3.75%–4.00% expected
events.why_it_matters: A hold is ~90% priced; the statement and Powell's tone will shape whether December hike odds stay above 70%.
events.what_to_watch: Dissents, the inflation paragraph, and any signal on the December 8–9 meeting.

events.title: Microsoft Q3 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Azure growth and AI capex guidance are the key read-through for the entire AI infrastructure trade.
events.what_to_watch: Azure constant-currency growth vs ~35% consensus and capex commentary.

events.title: Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Google Cloud growth and search-ad resilience will test whether AI spending is translating into revenue.
events.what_to_watch: Cloud operating margin and 2027 capex guide.

events.title: Amazon Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AWS growth and retail margins are the twin bellwethers for cloud AI demand and the US consumer.
events.what_to_watch: AWS growth vs ~20% consensus and holiday-quarter guidance.

events.title: Apple Q4 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: iPhone 17 cycle demand and China revenue will set the tone for consumer tech into the holiday season.
events.what_to_watch: Greater China revenue growth and services margin.

events.title: ECB rate decision — hold at 2.50% expected
events.why_it_matters: A hold is fully priced; Lagarde's guidance on December is the key swing factor for EUR and euro-area bonds.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Lagarde explicitly opens the door to a December hike despite weak PMIs.

events.title: BOJ rate decision — hold at 1.25% expected
events.why_it_matters: A hold is near-universally expected; the quarterly outlook report and Ueda's tone will drive December hike odds (~75–80% priced).
events.what_to_watch: Any upgrade to the inflation outlook and JPY reaction around 150/USD.

events.title: China October official PMI
events.why_it_matters: September manufacturing PMI returned to expansion at 50.1; October will show whether the recovery is holding.
events.what_to_watch: New export orders sub-index amid US tariff uncertainty.

events.title: Eurozone October flash CPI and Q3 GDP
events.why_it_matters: With PMIs disappointing, a weak GDP print alongside sticky inflation would complicate the ECB's December decision.
events.what_to_watch: Core HICP and whether Q3 GDP growth slows below 0.3% q/q.

events.title: US October nonfarm payrolls
events.why_it_matters: The first clean post-shutdown jobs report will be critical for the December Fed decision and midterm aftermath.
events.what_to_watch: Unemployment rate and average hourly earnings; a hot print cements a December hike.

events.title: US October CPI
events.why_it_matters: Following September's 3.7% y/y print, October CPI is the last major inflation data before the December FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Core services ex-shelter; a third consecutive upside surprise would lock in a December hike.

events.title: US midterm elections
events.why_it_matters: A Democratic sweep is not fully priced and could bring higher taxes and tighter regulation; a split Congress preserves gridlock.
events.what_to_watch: Senate and House control, and whether results are delayed or contested.

events.title: US Treasury quarterly refunding announcement
events.why_it_matters: Bessent's 'Treasury twist' could shift issuance toward bills and shorter maturities, affecting the long end and curve shape.
events.what_to_watch: Changes to 20- and 30-year auction sizes and buyback plans.

events.title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting
events.why_it_matters: With Brent above $111 on Hormuz risk, OPEC+ must decide whether to maintain November quotas or signal a supply response.
events.what_to_watch: Saudi/Russian position on unwinding voluntary cuts into 2027.

events.title: Anthropic IPO — S-1 filing and mid-November listing
events.why_it_matters: A mega-cap AI IPO could absorb liquidity from mega-cap tech and reset valuations across the AI complex.
events.what_to_watch: Valuation range in the S-1 and whether the roadshow prices before Thanksgiving.

events.title: China NPC Standing Committee session
events.why_it_matters: The session may review stimulus legislation and local-government debt measures ahead of the 2027 leadership transition.
events.what_to_watch: Any new fiscal package or property-sector support measures.

events.title: Saudi Aramco Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Aramco's results and dividend commitment are a bellwether for Gulf sovereign spending and oil-market sentiment.
events.what_to_watch: Free cash flow coverage of the base dividend and 2027 capex guidance.

events.title: Post-midterm US–Israel strike risk on Iran
events.why_it_matters: Reports indicate the US and Israel have plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the US midterms, a major tail risk for oil and risk assets.
events.what_to_watch: US carrier movements and any Iranian retaliation against Gulf shipping.

events.title: Amazon FTC antitrust trial
events.why_it_matters: The FTC's monopolisation case against Amazon could produce remedies affecting marketplace fees and Prime bundling.
events.what_to_watch: Trial schedule and any settlement talks.

top_risks: Post-midterm US/Israel strike on Iran could spike Brent well above $120 and force a global risk-off move.
A hot October CPI on Nov 10 combined with strong payrolls would cement a December Fed hike, pressuring long-duration equities.
A contested or delayed US midterm result could trigger volatility across rates and equities.
Brazil's post-election fiscal selloff could broaden into a broader EM contagion episode.
Anthropic's IPO could drain liquidity from mega-cap tech and trigger a rotation within the AI complex.
top_opportunities: A benign FOMC hold and soft payrolls could revive the 'Fed pause' trade, supporting rate-sensitive growth and small caps.
Semiconductor momentum (TSMC, Korea exports) suggests AI capex names can outperform through year-end.
A split Congress after the midterms would preserve gridlock and remove tail risks of higher corporate taxes.
OPEC+ maintaining quotas into 2027 would keep oil supported, benefiting energy equities and inflation hedges.
Eurozone flash CPI undershoot could weaken the euro and boost European exporters.
summary: Markets enter the final days of October with a Fed hold fully priced, sticky inflation, Brent above $111 on Hormuz risk, and a pivotal mega-cap earnings week. The FOMC today, US midterms on Nov 3, October CPI on Nov 10 and a possible post-election Iran escalation dominate the next two weeks, while Anthropic's IPO and China's NPC session add liquidity and policy risk. The main tension is between a market pricing a benign Fed pause and a data-dependent path that could force a December hike.
